title: Blueberry and Cucumber Infused Water
excerpt: A light, elegant refresher that pairs the coolness of cucumber with the natural sweetness of our high-mountain blueberries. Ideal for hydrating with a gourmet touch at any time of day.
imageAlt: A clear glass pitcher filled with crystal-clear water, floating blueberries, thin cucumber slices and fresh mint leaves on a rustic wooden table.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cucumber, cut into very thin slices

steps: Wash the cucumber slices and the mint leaves very well.
Take half of your Fresh Pick blueberries and gently press them with a fork at the bottom of a bowl so they release their juices and natural sweetness without falling apart completely.
In a large glass pitcher, place the lightly pressed blueberries together with the whole blueberries you set aside for garnish.
Add the cucumber slices and the mint leaves, giving the mint a light clap between your hands first to release its aroma.
Pour the liter of cold water over the mixture and stir gently with a long spoon.
Refrigerate the pitcher for at least one hour so the water absorbs all the aromas and takes on a lovely lilac tint.
Serve very cold in tall glasses with plenty of ice.
tips: Because Fresh Pick blueberries are grown in the high mountains of Guasca at more than 2,800 meters, the fruit is so sweet and juicy that you won’t need to add sugar or sweeteners to your water.
Don’t throw the fruit away when the water is gone. At the end of your drink you can eat the blueberries and the cucumber; they will have absorbed a delicious, refreshing hint of mint.
